title: Przypinki z czasów Solidarności 34 szt.
category: Polish Solidarność / historically specific PRL pins
expected_us_value: Selected identifiable pins can have $25-$35 sold comps; value varies heavily by design
why: Bulk cost is exactly at target; shipping weight is negligible; source lot allows breakup arbitrage.
notes: Verify lot is still live and inspect which designs are actually included before buying.

title: Bombki szklane PRL 12 sztuk
category: Vintage Polish hand-blown / indent glass Christmas ornaments
expected_us_value: Better vintage Polish ornaments sell individually/sets; a 9-piece indent lot sold for $54
why: Extremely low source cost creates room even after breakage and selective lotting.
notes: Prioritize indents, teardrops, figurals and hand-painted pieces; ordinary balls are less attractive.

title: Půvabná brož s beruškou, Jablonecko
expected_us_value: Vintage Czech/Jablonex brooches show U.S. market prices around $20-$80 depending on age, construction and design
why: Very low source price for an explicitly described old Jablonec glass-and-gilt-metal brooch; tiny shipping footprint. The spread works if the piece is genuinely older Czech production.
notes: Inspect clasp/back and age cues. Do not pay Jablonex collector value merely because the seller selected the Jablonex brand field.

title: Odznaky a iné — retro badge lot
category: Czechoslovak / socialist-era badges and small collectibles
expected_us_value: Generic badges can be low value, while identifiable institutions, units, factories, events and awards can reach $20+
why: At 3 EUR for the entire group, only one desirable badge is needed to create a strong spread; international master-box weight is negligible.
notes: This is a photo-identification play, not a blind category buy. Read every visible inscription before purchasing.

title: Vintage Kalocsai kézi hímzés zipper pouch
expected_us_value: Recent U.S. sold Kalocsa hand-embroidered pieces include $22.50, $34.99, $35 and $42; garments can be much higher
why: Source cost is only a few dollars, the piece is lightweight and visually distinctive, and there is repeated U.S. demand for genuine Kalocsa hand embroidery.
notes: The sold comps are not the exact pouch format. Confirm genuine hand embroidery and treat $20-$30 as a conservative test expectation until the auction proves demand.

title: Gintaro komplektukas — amber necklace and bracelet set
expected_us_value: Recent genuine Baltic amber necklace sales include $22, $40, $53.15 and much higher weight-dependent results; a Lithuania amber bracelet sold for $39.90
why: Excellent source price versus demonstrated U.S. demand, very low shipping weight, and Lithuania is a natural source market. The entire thesis depends on the material being genuine amber rather than imitation/resin.
notes: Ask for gram weight, clasp close-ups and UV/photo evidence if possible. Avoid pricing from exceptional heavy butterscotch amber comps unless the item actually matches.

title: Broșă — no label, green, very good condition
category: Vintage Czech / Czechoslovak glass costume jewelry
expected_us_value: Only attractive if construction/markings identify it as older Czech/Czechoslovak glass
why: Price is cheap enough to inspect; Vinted Romania is a useful hunting ground, but this listing is not a blind buy without back/mark photos.
notes: Ask for back, clasp and markings. PASS if modern generic fashion jewelry.

title: Low-cost communist-era badges appearing on Vinted Romania
expected_us_value: Generic communist badges are often low value; specific factories, awards, units and events can be much better
why: Shows Vinted Romania has the right low-cost supply environment; the opportunity is selectivity, not buying every badge.
notes: Use exact inscription, institution and date before deciding.

title: Kalocsai hand-embroidered small linens
source_price: Current search examples around 1,000-2,000 HUF each; some multi-piece lots 1,499-1,999 HUF
why: Strong geographic pricing spread, very low shipping weight, easy visual story for reseller buyers.
notes: Confirm hand embroidery and condition. Prefer vivid floral pieces and small bundles.
